CA.rationale: An origin processing tag (history_estimate) is explicitly bound to the same current red content (n3).

COD.rationale: Content (red at p0/current/n0) and its origin/presentation metadata are both explicitly present, and status is separately indicated via origin.

A.rationale: Processing/estimate origin entries (command_estimate, history_estimate) are explicitly tied to specific content instances, linking processing/attention conditions to content presentation.

C.rationale: Multiple explicit content entries identify represented content and attributes (red coordinates) at current and candidate times.

D.rationale: Content identification (red coordinates) is presented alongside separate origin/status metadata for the same referent, differentiating identity from presentation/status.

O.rationale: Entries describe how contents are presented (origin metadata for current content; candidate-structured entries show organizational presentation).
